dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Hello, child! How can I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Irfan...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Oh, him... We are childhood friends. He went to Port Ormos and became a merchant, then got married and lived well...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: I haven't had drinks and talked with him in a long time... We didn't get to see each other before he died a few years ago...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Siman...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Hm...? Oh, her...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: "The child born in the middle of sands cherishes green more than anyone else." This sentence probably is about her...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: She should have followed in her father's footsteps and become a mercenary, adventuring in the vast desert... But she chose the path of a researcher.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: She was born cut out for a mercenary, through and through. To achieve her goals, she'd act regardless of the cost or the consequences, even her own life...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: I tried to understand her, but I was too young, and it turned out quite unpleasant... So, it is as you see. We have been apart for many years... many decades, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: I hope she is doing well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the medical history...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Medical history? Medical history...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Oh! You saw it? My medical history?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Haha... You saw it, huh... You saw it.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: They said I would forget everything in the end. I would forget everything I learned in my life, forget my best friend... everyone and everything.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: When that day comes, I will lose my memory, my everything, my sense of being alive. Then I'll forget why I exist. I am destined to be like that... sooner or later...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: So until then, at least until then... I want to do what I want. Just stay in the place I want to die in.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Forgetting cannot stop my steps, and neither can Siman...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Haha, don't let me keep you for too long, child!
